hints.title: Block Decomposition
hints.text: Any valid binary string is composed of full blocks of either oneGroup 1s or zeroGroup 0s.

hints.title: Linear Length Transitions
hints.text: The number of strings of length i equals the number of strings of length i - oneGroup plus length i - zeroGroup.

hints.title: Range Aggregation
hints.text: Sum the DP counts for all lengths from minLength to maxLength modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: 1D Binary Block DP Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass 1D recurrence filling array up to maxLength.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all binary strings takes exponential O(2^maxLength) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(maxLength) memory to store DP states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models contiguous groups as atomic blocks and establishes Fibonacci-like linear recurrence.
